description: What the MadMusic window is allowed to do. Deny-by-default: anything not listed here is unavailable to the frontend even if the plugin is compiled in. Global shortcuts, OS media controls, casting and the local control endpoint are all driven from Rust, so the frontend needs no permission for them beyond the commands themselves. Launching at login is the exception among those: the plugin is called from the settings screen rather than from Rust, so it needs a permission here - and without one the switch failed silently with a console warning nobody was reading. `opener:allow-reveal-item-in-dir` is here for the library's folder row, which opens the music folder in Explorer or Finder; `lib/desktop.ts` is its only caller and it is only ever passed the library root, a path the OS picker already returned.
